label: sdc01_0220_gfather_01
text: Good morning to you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_01
text: Tsk, he’s awake, huh.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_brother_02
text: Wanna go see the last signboard?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_02
text: Kiki, go find someplace else to be![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_04
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s got business with me![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_brother_03
text: Seriously? [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s spending all h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser time with you...\nThat’s so unfair! You can be such a jerk...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_05
text: What’d you just call me?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_06
text: What’s his deal? Kiki should know better than\nto talk back to me like that.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_02
text: That’s enough, Carmine! Be kind to your\nyounger brother.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_07
text: I WAS being kind! It’s not like I hit him\nor anything![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_08
text: Anyway, we’ve got more important things to\ndiscuss, right, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_09
text: C’mon! You gotta show Grandpa that thing\nyou have![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_04
text: Hm. And this is...?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_10
text: No, not that! I’m talkin’ about that thing we\nfound yesterday![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_05
text: Could this be...?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_06
text: This mask—it belongs to that poor ogre!\nWhere did you find this?![VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_11
text: We bumped into it! The ogre, I mean!\nYesterday, at the Festival of Masks![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_12
text: I tried talking to it all nice and everything, but it\ndropped that mask and... Yeah.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_07
text: I never would have thought that the ogre would\nstill be gracing our festival with its presence...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_13
text: Huh? What do you mean “still”? I thought the\nogre was a scoundrel that attacked the village.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_08
text: I suppose it’s time I told you, Carmine...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_09
text: You see, the truth of what happened with that\nogre...is the other way around.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_14
text: The other way around? What do you mean?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_10
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You should hear this too, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. You
also
met
the
poor
ogre...
Or
[VAR 0xFF00(0001)]Ogerpon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],

rightly named.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_gfather_11
text: Let me tell you the true story, as passed down\nthrough our family for generations...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0220_sister_15
text: The ogre is called Ogerpon?! And the real story’s\n“the other way around”? What does that even\r\nmean?! Come on, we need to hear this out![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
